subject: Harborside: readiness check-in & signatory path
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Harris <olivia@harborside.io>, Paul Nguyen <paul.nguyen@harborside.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Harborside: readiness check-in & signatory path

Hi Olivia / Paul — thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned: 

What we covered:
- Pilot intent: small production pilot (3 months) to validate latency/cost targets; prefer quick ramp via the cloud marketplace for initial billing.
- Commercial preference: for long-term production they expect a net-new contract with a PO (preferred) rather than corporate card.
- Approvals: Paul indicated he’s the functional sponsor; Olivia is procurement lead. Finance signatory is likely Leila Ramos (we don’t have her on the thread yet).
- Compliance asks: SOC 2 and audit log retention details requested; they’ll include these in procurement questionnaire.

Actions / asks (owner / ETA):
1) Camila: share a short SOW + pricing options for (marketplace trial / annual PO) — attached SOW template (see stub). ETA: Tue 6/2.
2) Harborside: confirm signatory name & PO timing; indicate whether they want charge-on-card for pilot.
3) Redwood: prepare procurement questionnaire answers and SOC 2 pointer (Ben to own).

Attachments: Harborside_SOW_template.pdf (draft SOW)

If you can confirm the signatory and whether the pilot should be on the marketplace versus a card charge, I’ll put together the SOW + short commercial summary.

Thanks — Camila
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142
From: Paul Nguyen <paul.nguyen@harborside.io>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Olivia Harris <olivia@harborside.io>
Date: Sun, 31 May 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Harborside: readiness check-in & signatory path

Camila — thanks for the recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- I am the economic buyer for this integration and can greenlight the pilot budget.
- Finance signatory is Leila Ramos (Leila will need the SOW and an invoice/contract to route internally). I’ve cc’d Olivia since she’s running procurement.
- For the pilot we prefer marketplace billing if it doesn’t add security overhead; if the marketplace is not feasible, we will submit a PO. Pilot is targeted to start the week of 6/14.
- Timeline: procurement will aim to route anything requiring a PO within 2–3 weeks after receiving the SOW + contract redlines.

I attached our procurement questionnaire with some baseline answers — will update if finance asks for more detail.

Paul Nguyen
VP Product | Harborside Health
paul.nguyen@harborside.io
Attachment: Procurement_Questionnaire_Answers.xlsx
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Paul Nguyen <paul.nguyen@harborside.io>, Olivia Harris <olivia@harborside.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 11:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Harborside: readiness check-in & signatory path

Paul — great, thanks for confirming you as the economic buyer and providing Leila’s name. Next steps from Redwood side: 

- I’ll send an SOW with two commercial routes: (A) 3-month pilot via marketplace (fast start, card/marketplace bill), (B) Annual subscription by PO (preferred for production).
- Ben will attach our SOC 2 summary and answers to the questionnaire you sent — Ben, can you add the audit-log retention note?
- Can you confirm who will sign the PO (Leila or a delegated signatory) and whether Harborside legal needs a copy before routing? That’ll help us choose between marketplace vs PO for the pilot.

Target: share SOW + pricing Tuesday 6/2 EOD PT. If you’re ok with the pilot start week of 6/14, we’ll tentatively block that in the calendar and prep access.

Attachment: Harborside_SOW_template.pdf (sent for completeness)

Best — Camila
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Harborside procurement notes (SOC2 / audit logs)

Internal note — quick checklist before we send answers back: 
- SOC 2: provide latest letter + pointer to our security page (I’ll attach the SOC2 summary PDF to the questionnaire answers).
- Audit logs: Harborside asked about retention and exportability. We should specify 90-day default retention and options for 12/24/indefinite via dedicated private deployment.
- Billing: recommend we call out marketplace for pilot (fastest), but include clear steps for PO route (SOW + Master Services Agreement + 2 weeks routing).
- Legal/Finance escalation: if Leila routes to Legal, Sales Ops should pre-seed a redline with common commerce terms to speed review.

Recommendation: Offer both routes in the SOW, mark marketplace as the fast path, and include a one-page commercial summary highlighting PO timeline and signatory requirements.

Ben
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

2) Confirm whether you prefer the marketplace pilot or to start via a short-term PO.

Once we have that, Sales Ops will push a pre-seeded SOW + DocuSign package (link below) and Legal will be on standby for any redlines. Proposed meeting to finalize: Thu 6/4 10am PT — ok for you?
